headline: Bentley take the first away win between members
dek: Bentley's single goal at Adelphi made them the first side to beat another member away from home; every other meeting has gone to the home side or been drawn. Ten days before, Bentley had lost by five at Franklin Pierce. Pace and Southern New Hampshire have still to lose to anyone.
displaced_by: Bentley won at Adelphi, the first away win between members; the standing dek's claim that no member had lost at home to another is no longer true

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's twenty-six goals are spread across at least thirteen scorers, so no single player carries the tallest bar; Pace sit mid-chart on eleven, and the four they have conceded is the smaller figure that explains their unbeaten record.

wire.line: Away sides had not won a meeting between members until Bentley did at Adelphi, ten days after losing by five at Franklin Pierce.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bentley's win at Adelphi was the first by an away side in the eight meetings between members; five went to the home side and two were drawn.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cody Holbert has scored nine of Assumption's eighteen goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have lost four matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored six goals from fifteen shots for Franklin Pierce.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Joe Zweben has made twenty-eight saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

last_match.line: Bentley have not lost since their defeat at Franklin Pierce; Adelphi had gone back-to-back matches without conceding.

next_match.line: Both sides open their conference schedule; Pace have yet to lose, and Saint Anselm's winning run ended at Assumption.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
